findings.description: Appending estimates changes version-1 tuples from six columns to seven, or bar tuples from seven to eight. An already-open client that first crosses the base zoom gate after deployment reads the new unversioned manifest, then rejects these rows with the previous decoder. Because parseUkBaseShardForEntry requires the full count, it discards whole cells. The published data affects 548 of 625 shards. Preserve the existing tuple contract, for example with additive estimate metadata outside the tuples. Related sites: scripts/build_uk_base_shards.mjs:477 publishes version 1, lib/ukBasePubs.ts:137 changes tuple acceptance, scripts/validate-data.mjs:1976 mirrors the new arities, public/data/uk_base/manifest.json:1 selects the incompatible generation. Deployment recovery does not run on a shard parse failure.

Estimate metadata is emitted only after the label qualifies for display. Tap a newly loaded base pin before its presence request completes: ukBasePubFromFeature returns no estimate, and PubMap retains that object as selectedBasePub. The sheet then never requests presence or displays the estimate, even when the map later gains its label. The same loss occurs on the server fallback for a shared link without a location hint because parseUkBaseRestoreResponse discards the returned estimate. Preserve validated model metadata across selection and restore independently of label visibility. Related changed-file sites: lib/ukBasePubs.ts:601 gates metadata, lib/ukBasePubs.ts:662 reconstructs only emitted metadata, components/map/pubmap/useUkBaseStreaming.ts:315 initially publishes without presence, components/map/pubmap/useUkBaseStreaming.ts:181 drops estimate fields during API restore, components/map/UnverifiedPubSheet.tsx:240 and :268 require the lost estimate.

Simplification: remove the second London borough baseline resolver at lines 93-99 and its baseline/boundary reads at line 25. The only caller, scripts/build_uk_price_bundle.mjs:582, invokes this model only after estimateForPub already tries the chain and borough baselines. No intent requirement needs another owner of that decision. The narrower sampled fallback needs only nearby, locality and postcode-area estimates.

Simplification: remove the optional standalone mode that reads an existing bundle and manifest when inputs are absent. The sole caller at scripts/build_uk_price_bundle.mjs:309 supplies both bundleRows and computedAt. No intent requirement needs this additional loading path. Require those inputs and remove the unused computedAt return field at scripts/lib/loadUkEstimateModel.mjs:103.

risk_rationale: The change can remove most base-map cells for existing clients and lose available estimates during normal selection and shared-link restoration.
testing_summary: Reviewed aa1eab9df3ed62945f7d9e760c5dc019432d51a9..d404163d7ee66fab57f0587ce787f8c547f2add3. Read and judged all 1,318 changed paths, including deleted packs through git history. Read-only data inspection compared all old and new base rows, estimate projections, city outputs and bundle authority rows. No tests, builds, browser sessions, network operations or pipeline phases ran. No source changes were made.
